To reduce model complexity, the owner computes the optimal $$	heta$$ by minimizing the following regularized loss function:
$$L(	heta)=(||Y-X{	heta}||_2)**{2}+\lambda{g}(	heta)$$
where $$g{\left(	hetaight)}$$ is a non-constant function of $$	heta$$ and $$\lambda$$ is at least $$0.$$ If the magnitude of any $$	heta_i$$ increases, $$g{\left(	hetaight)}$$ will also increase.
Which of the following options reduces model complexity?
choices: Changing $$\lambda$$ has no effect on model complexity.
Both increasing and decreasing $$\lambda$$ reduce complexity.
The effect depends on the choice of $$\text{g}(\theta).$$
